last_lineage_decision.reason: The hold-exit forfeiture did not produce the expected reduction in interrupted holds. On the identical 500-episode research panel, the baseline working policy achieved 97.4% while the changed-reward checkpoints achieved 95.4%, 83.4%, and 85.6%, with interruption failures increasing substantially at the measured later checkpoints. The independent task-reference panel also remained below the baseline result at 96.0%, 84.0%, and 85.0% versus 98.0%. No additional measurement is needed to choose the lineage: the intervention is not a useful path under the tested transfer and budget, while a scientifically useful observation/control investigation remains.
